title: eludite/resx/designer
description: Generate, delete or change the access modifier of a neutral `.resx` file's designer code file (proposal 0005; host-rpc.md, "Resources"). `generate` reads the `.resx` from disk (after the shell saved it) and writes the designer in the shape `ResXFileCodeGenerator` (`internal`) or `PublicResXFileCodeGenerator` (`public`) writes: the header comment, the namespace, the class with `ResourceManager` and `Culture`, one property per string entry in file order, the file's non-string entries typed by their `type` (`System.Drawing.Bitmap`, `System.Drawing.Icon`, `System.IO.UnmanagedMemoryStream` for audio, `byte[]` for binary files, `string` for text files); a key that is not a valid identifier is made one as the generator does (`StronglyTypedResourceBuilder.VerifyResourceName`: invalid characters to `_`, a leading digit prefixed with `_`, keywords prefixed with `_`). Nothing is written when the file would not change. `setModifier` sets or removes the item's `Generator` metadata with the construction model (preserving formatting; an SDK project's globbed item gets an `Update` item), then generates or, for `none`, deletes the designer file. `delete` deletes the designer file and keeps the metadata.

modifier.description: With `setModifier`: the new modifier. With `generate`: the modifier to write when the item has no `Generator` and no designer exists (default `internal`).

designer.description: The designer file written, deleted or left as it was.

status.description: written (the designer file changed), unchanged (it already had this content), deleted, none (no designer: `none` modifier and no file, or the project does not list the file).

modifier.description: The modifier in effect after the call.
